task_description: Make the 4A Store Expo SDK 54 mobile app local-first and resilient so no screen hangs on a bare spinner, and harden the 401/refresh/session path. Local-first saved-address store + optimistic checkout save/proceed; per-user orders cache + skeleton; CMS page cache + skeleton; optimistic staff order status change; 401 refresh audit. No new npm dependency; do not touch tracking or rider flow; do not change the server/API or response shapes; reuse existing Shimmer only (no visual restyle).
